answer: Random full-state query proof: each epoch the network asks every agent ten random questions about the ledger itself — a balance in a vine of old blocks, a hash on a knoll of history — answerable within five seconds only by a synced full node. Three peers check each answer against their own nodes; a wrong or slow reply freezes the identity three epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 full nodes at 500 GB each, about $30,000 a month, while one honest agent runs the node it already keeps and answers in seconds for free — the delta shows in the first missed query.
